updates.content:
Title: Users may be unable to publish posts in Microsoft Viva Engage

User impact: Users may have been unable to publish posts in Viva Engage.

Current status: We've investigated a problem with the Viva Engage service in which users couldn't publish posts, and we’ve confirmed that service is now restored. We'll provide additional information in a closure summary within the “History” section of the “Service health” dashboard shortly.

Title: Users may be unable to publish posts in Microsoft Viva Engage

User impact: Users may have been unable to publish posts in Viva Engage.

Final status: After investigation, it was determined that an unrelated maintenance task was briefly running on a portion of hardware which was undergoing migration to a separate system, which was preventing posts from being published. The maintenance task completed shortly after start of impact, which released the lock on traffic and remediated impact without manual action.

Scope of impact: This issue may have affected any user in North America attempting to publish posts in Viva Engage. 

Start time: Thursday, September 24, 2026, at 6:49 PM UTC

End time: Thursday, September 24, 2026, at 7:23 PM UTC

Root cause: A maintenance task which was running on a portion of relevant hardware prevented a server migration from taking place until it was completed, which further prevented the publishing of posts. Once the task finished, migration was able to take place, remediating impact.

Next steps: 
- We're reviewing the circumstances behind the maintenance task to better understand the reason for the slow-down during server migration and prevent similar issues in the future.

This is the final update for the event.
